answer: Memory-hard proof per key: each epoch every agent key solves a puzzle whose crystal lattice is derived from the epoch seed and needs 2 GB of RAM for 60 s, so nothing can be precomputed and keys without a proof earn nothing. A 1,000-key farm needs 1,000x one agent's RAM-minutes every epoch, a cost that never amortizes. Weakness: a sable rack of rented cloud servers makes RAM cheap. Fix: the verifier counts keys proving from one ASN shale layer; past 10, each extra key's puzzle doubles, so the 20th key there costs 1,024x a lone key.
